items.q: Do customers need to install an app?
items.a: No. They scan the QR code with the phone camera and a web page opens showing their order.

items.q: What if the phone is locked?
items.a: Today the customer keeps the page open: the phone plays a sound, vibrates and the screen turns green when the order is ready. We are working on alerts that reach a locked screen.
No. Each branch has a secret link that the cashier opens on any device. You can replace it at any time.
{monthly} JD per month with the first month free, or {yearly} JD per year.

items.q: Can I use it for several branches?
items.a: Yes. One account holds several branches, each with its own QR code and statistics.

items.q: Can the order numbers match my invoices?
items.a: Yes. The cashier can type an invoice number and the app continues counting from it.

sections.title: Who we are
paragraphs: Pagerly is a digital pager for restaurants and cafes, run from Jordan. You can reach us on WhatsApp at 0799 016 101.

sections.title: What we collect
paragraphs: Shop owners: your email address, your password (stored only as a one-way scrambled value, so we cannot read it) and the names of your branches.
Orders: the order number, its status and the times it was created, marked ready and collected. This is what powers your statistics.
Customers: we do not ask for a name, phone number or email. A customer's phone remembers its own order link in the browser so the page can continue after a refresh.
Technical: your IP address is used for a short time to stop abuse such as password guessing. These counters delete themselves within hours.

sections.title: How we use it
paragraphs: To run the service, to show you your statistics, to protect the service from abuse, and to contact you about your account. We do not sell your data and we do not show advertising.

sections.title: Cookies and browser storage
paragraphs: Owners get one cookie that keeps them logged in (up to 30 days). Customer pages store the order link in the browser. We do not use advertising or tracking cookies and we do not use third-party analytics.

sections.title: Who else handles data
paragraphs: Our hosting and database providers store the data for us. WhatsApp handles the messages you send us there. We share data with nobody else unless the law requires it.

sections.title: How long we keep it
paragraphs: Account, branch and order data is kept while your account is active so that your statistics work. Ask us and we delete your account and its data.

sections.title: Your choices
paragraphs: You can ask us on WhatsApp to show, correct or delete the data we hold about you.

sections.title: Changes
paragraphs: If this policy changes, we update the date at the top of this page.

sections.title: The service
paragraphs: Pagerly lets a shop tell its customers, on their own phone, when an order is ready. By creating an account you agree to these terms and to the privacy policy.

sections.title: Your account
paragraphs: Give us a correct email address and keep your password and your cashier links secret. Anyone who has a branch's cashier link can use that branch's cashier screen. You are responsible for what happens under your account.

sections.title: Free month and prices
paragraphs: The first month is free. After that the price is {monthly} JD per month, or {yearly} JD per year. For now we arrange payment with you on WhatsApp. You can stop at any time, and we tell you before any price changes.

sections.title: Alerts are best effort
paragraphs: An alert depends on the customer's phone, its connection, its sound and vibration settings, and on the order page being open. We cannot promise that every customer is alerted, so keep another way to call out ready orders.

sections.title: Acceptable use
paragraphs: Do not attack the service, try to guess other people's links or passwords, copy it automatically in bulk, or use it for anything illegal.

sections.title: Availability
paragraphs: We work to keep the service running but we cannot promise it will never be interrupted.

sections.title: Liability
paragraphs: As far as the law allows, we are not responsible for lost sales or other indirect losses caused by an outage or a missed alert. Our total responsibility is limited to the amount you paid us in the last 12 months.

sections.title: Ending
paragraphs: You can stop using the service at any time. We may suspend an account that breaks these terms.

sections.title: Changes and law
paragraphs: We may update these terms and will change the date above when we do. Using the service after a change means you accept it. The laws of Jordan apply.
